<h1>DSteele</h1>

<div class="hero-subtitle">
A 3D spectral-element / finite-layer model for pavement response under moving loads
</div>

<p>DSteele was developed to simulate layered flexible-pavement response under vehicle loads traveling at constant speed, with Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) applications as a central motivation.</p>

<p><a href="../posts/dsteele-overview/index.html" class="btn btn-primary">Start with the DSteele overview</a></p>
